newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NBNZ, CSFB place NZ$88 mln TransAlta NZ 2006 bonds.
newsitem.headline: NBNZ, CSFB place NZ$88 mln TransAlta NZ 2006 bonds.

text.p: National Bank of New Zealand Ltd said on Tuesday it had placed NZ$88 million of TransAlta NZ 10-year bonds with local institutions.
CS First Boston co-managed the placement.
The A-rated senior bonds, maturing on October 1, 2006, were placed at a 76-point margin over government stock.
The issue was in connection with a capital restructuring linked to the merger of Wellington power companies Capital Power and EnergyDirect to form TransAlta NZ.

Existing shareholders received equity, capital notes, seven-year bonds and 10-year bonds. National Bank said its involvement stemmed from the decision by some major shareholders to sell down their 10-year bonds.
The rate will be set this Friday and settlement is October 1. --Wellington Newsroom (64 4) 4734746
